Community-reported Chapter 2 exploit, not unlimited free registrations. Keep Moses' Find a suitable vehicle objective active and the one-time waiver unused. Save separately.

1. As Lucia, visit the modern white mansion off Sabal Circle, southern Starfish Island, just past the figure-eight driveway. A Rosy Palms pickup is reported nearby.
2. Angle the pickup along the right garage door, leaving a narrow gap. Squeeze into it; crouch (Circle/B), move toward door and open phone (D-pad Up). Adjust position and retry. If you fall through the map, reload.
3. Once inside, close phone, use Open at the center post and drive out in Andrew Node's Thrax. WAiNK-scan for tracker and eligibility.
4. Return to Watkins Auto Parts, finish Slim Jim tutorial if needed, respray and register only if FREE. Normally $70,000; unique name/paint may change.

If waiver already used, Chapter 3 No Flusher route unlocks the garage normally but registration costs money. Reported Nov 23-25; may be patched. See Standout Vehicles > Andrew Node's Thrax for map and normal route.

Nov 25 tracker recheck lists the method as still reported, but has no submitted player tests. Treat as an exploit report, not proof of current build compatibility.

Community-reported Story Mode exploit (B Man, Nov 24; Xbox 1.0.2.2). Not independently tested on PS5. Save to a separate slot.

1. Go to Apollo Aggregates east of Hamlet. Bring a registered car with two stash slots and both playable characters unlocked. Prepare one full bag and one nearly empty bag.
2. Take the FULL bag out first, then the nearly empty one. At the loot van, repeatedly use ONLY the side with the paired Collect prompts. Avoid the single-item prompt: it may fill the wrong bag and break the method.
3. Stow both bags, switch characters and back to reset warehouse loot. Retrieve full bag first and repeat. Check the actual bag value after each pass. The published demonstration used four loot vans; whether duplicating them is necessary is not established.
4. Sell a small test load first. Tyrone (C3) is the reported buyer for the large sale. A video shows over $100,000 in one bag and roughly $116,000 sale; neither is guaranteed. Keep enough BuckMe headroom for the entire pending payout. Check real credited balance, not just bag UI.

Smaller alternative (single player report): at $8,400 bag value, quickly collect two adjacent cocaine pickups; reported $10,800 instead of $9,600. Capacities vary by contents. If overfill fails, use normal warehouse loop. See Infinite Money Glitch > Map.

Nov 25 tracker recheck lists this as reported working, without submitted player tests. The normal save/reload warehouse route has stronger post-patch evidence than the single-bag overflow.

Story Mode exploit reported Nov 27, 2026; may be patched. Make a separate manual save and test with a low-value bag first. This increases the value of the contents, not the number of bags.

1. Obtain a stash bag containing marked bills, jewelry or narcotics. Move somewhere safe before starting.
2. Crouch and stay in place. Do not move the left stick throughout the drop/pickup cycle.
3. Open the weapon wheel (PS5 L1 / Xbox LB), switch to Items (R1 / RB), highlight the stash bag and hold Circle / B to drop it.
4. Turn only the camera with the right stick until the pickup prompt appears. Pick up the bag (use the displayed prompt; commonly Triangle / Y). Check its value.
5. Repeat while crouched. Each successful cycle reportedly adds the starting value again (e.g. $10,000 becomes $20,000, then $30,000), rather than doubling the new total each time. Reports indicate about 8-12 cycles per bag; stop if the value no longer rises.

Two bags: drop bag 2 first, then bag 1, without moving. Pick both up using the same camera-only method and check each value. Repeat if both increase. One bag is sufficient; no vehicle swap, partner switch or warehouse reset is required.

Sell the bag to a story-unlocked fence or lockup; the displayed bag value is not spendable cash. Verify actual payment, demand and bank limits. Donnie, Dunk and Brian are earlier options; Tyrone is available from Chapter 3 and may offer better narcotics rates. Do not overwrite your backup if the bag disappears, the payout is wrong, or the exploit fails.

Additional player reports: a level surface can help; the two-bag drop/retrieve variant has been reported outside the warehouse using only one character. If a pickup prompt stops working, one player reports switching protagonists and returning restores access. Bag values can reset unexpectedly; reported caps differ by loot and account progression. Some sales remain pending when the BuckMe limit is reached. Check the actual credit before repeating.
Two-bag variant (Unconfirmed): try a full bag and one holding a single brick; tap the pickup button repeatedly as you release L1/LB. Start a fresh bag when duplication stops.
Marked bills variation (Unconfirmed): crouch before collecting the bills from an ATM in-game, then stay crouched for the entire drop and retrieval cycle.
Barn variation (Unconfirmed): stow a full bag and a second bag holding one brick in the van before switching protagonists and back. Retrieve the full bag first. Collect bricks from the left side of the barn to add them to the full bag.

Experimental separate method (Bubs, Nov 24): a stuck trunk count is not the same as overfilling one bag. At Apollo Aggregates, fill an available 10-slot van and your registered car. Drive the van to Dunk and unload all bags by hand. Bring your registered car up and remove two bags. If the count stays unchanged (reported 3/4), try a small additional sale and verify actual bank credit. Payout can be zero or inconsistent. Unregistered van variant is risky: never rely on its cargo persisting through save/reload. The existing two-owned-car route is safer for normal loot storage. Keep a backup; stop if not credited.\n\nNov 25 tracker lists the method but records no submitted player tests; the frozen counter alone does not demonstrate a successful payout.

Max Focus stat farming (not Unlimited Focus cheat). Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range, northeast Port Gellhorn (Kelly County). Save first. Pay $5 waiver at clerk; choose Market Range Beginner. Use pistol (rental if needed). Clear six targets, about 5 seconds. At results choose Quit and exit to range, then start the challenge fresh. Do NOT choose Restart: community video reports the stat gain is credited on exit.

Repeat until purple eye Focus reaches Level 4 / max in Jason & Lucia > character profile. About 5% per run is a creator estimate, not guaranteed. Check before and after a few runs. Train other character separately after Coffee Break (C2). Focus increases duration of combat slow-motion (L3+R3); it is not permanently infinite. No cheat activation. PowerPyx corroborates this repeatable course; Nov 23 patch notes did not mention it. See Shooting Gold Medals > Market - Beginner for map.

Nov 25 tracker recheck lists the course method as reported working; no independent player tests are recorded there.

Community report; PS5 and Xbox controls reported. Save in a separate slot before testing.

In Settings > Controller, assign the touchpad (PS5) or View button (Xbox) to Camera instead of Map. Sit in the driver seat. Open the phone with D-pad Up; close with Circle/B, then immediately tap the camera button repeatedly. Retry until the first-person view persists. Exit the vehicle to check walking view. The camera can behave incorrectly during animations. Reload the manual save to restore normal view. Post-November 23 patch reports exist; not independently tested.
Community tracker reports this method after update 01.002.002 / 1.0.2.2 (Nov 27); not independently reproduced.

Reported Story Mode method, Chapter 2 onward; both protagonists and a fence must be available. Separate manual save first. Deposit carried cash at an ATM. Pick a raid and park your vehicle near it. Clear and loot the site with one character. Switch to the other character and order the partner to drive and fence the goods. Remain at the site until the sale message arrives, then let the in-game character be killed by guards or police. On respawn, check whether enemies and loot have reset and recall your partner. Reported examples at Jax's garage and other raids vary in payout. Death can lose carried cash; never assume a successful reset or credited sale. November 24 report did not identify the game build.

Mixed community reports; a November 23 video reports success after update 01.002.002. Keep a separate save. After the prologue, rob shops and clear the in-game Wanted level. Start an available story mission that opens with a cutscene (Meet Brian is a reported example). While the cutscene is playing, pause and select Restart Mission. After the transition, pause again and select Quit Mission. Check the map to see whether the shops reopened. Some missions and saves do not work; quitting alone is inconsistent. Stop if the shop remains closed or progress is affected.\nCommunity tracker lists reports on update 01.002.002 / 1.0.2.2 (Nov 27); results may vary.

column1: Xbox Series X Frame Rate Glitch
column3: Experimental report, not a confirmed 60 FPS mode. Xbox Series X only; reports involve a display supporting 120 Hz and VRR and Quick Resume. Current 1.0.2.2 behavior is not established; the game may run too quickly. Do not treat it as an official performance mode. If timing or physics is wrong, close the game completely and relaunch. Preserve a manual save.\nTracker lists testing on 01.002.001 only; compatibility with 1.0.2.2 remains unconfirmed.

Community-reported Story Mode collision bug. Save separately. Find a narrow corner or gap, crouch, and open the phone. Some wall or garage collisions may fail. Reload your clean save if trapped below the world. See Free Thrax glitch for the mission-specific vehicle acquisition; this general method does not waive registration fees.

Community-reported alternate escape route during Lucia’s prologue; may be a scripted shortcut rather than a true glitch. Not independently tested.

During the rooftop escape, drop to street level, cross into the alley opposite, and head to the waterway. Take the parked boat. A player report says this advances to the construction-site scene early. Other recorded water routes still return to the scripted story, so a time saving is not guaranteed.

If the route fails, follow the normal chase or restart from the checkpoint. Do not rely on this to escape the scripted outcome. Reports were current on Nov 27, 2026.
Community tracker reports this route on update 01.002.002 / 1.0.2.2 (Nov 27); whether intended is unknown.

Lucia wardrobe glitch, reported Nov 26, 2026. Save separately before testing.

Required clothing: Open Denim Cutoffs and any one-piece swimsuit from De'Luge Swimwear, Ocean Beach; Distressed Trucker Denim Jacket and any sports bra from Bargain World, Port Gellhorn.

1. At a wardrobe, equip the cutoffs, then the swimsuit.
2. Select the Distressed Trucker Denim Jacket and set Wear Style to 1/3.
3. Select the sports bra, then immediately press Triangle (PS5) / Y (Xbox) once to equip the jacket.
4. Exit the wardrobe and check the outfit.

The reported effect is missing lower-body clothing. Do not save this outfit: the game reportedly restores the shorts when saving it. If the clothing is restored, retry the timing or select a normal outfit. Patch and regional compatibility are not established. Source: Game Secret, Nov 26.

Lucia wardrobe and armor glitch, reported working Nov 27, 2026. Use a separate manual save.

Required: long denim jacket from Bargain World in Port Gellhorn, a top, a one-piece dress, flip-flops, a vehicle with outfit storage, standard Body Armor and a grenade from Ammu-Nation.

1. At a wardrobe, equip the long jacket, set Wear Style to 3/3 (closed), and remove the top underneath using Triangle (PS5) / Y (Xbox).
2. Save the jacket outfit using Triangle / Y; highlight it and use Square / X to add it to the trunk.
3. Change to the dress and equip Body Armor from inventory after leaving the wardrobe.
4. At the trunk, select the saved jacket outfit. Check that the armor has replaced the jacket.
5. Return to the wardrobe, select flip-flops, and save the resulting outfit in another slot.
6. In-game, deplete the armor; the reported method uses grenade damage. The outfit may revert or the character may be injured. Reload the backup if needed.

Reported result: missing upper-body clothing. Not an official cheat. Outfit changes may restore normal clothing; patch and regional compatibility can vary. Source: Insider Gaming, Nov 27.

Unconfirmed. Save separately. In Chapter 3 or later, visit US-82 near Tola Bay, opposite Richardson Hunting Supplies, or Forest Mill Rd southwest of Millport. Look for a sheriff or unmarked Bison 1800 towing a construction trailer. If a civilian truck appears, leave and return or switch protagonists and back to reroll the spawn. Take the police truck to Pay n Spray and select Register if offered. The registered truck reportedly retains its siren, lights and radio and accepts Bison modifications. Reported working after the November 23 update; not applicable to ordinary stolen cruisers.
